name: @fezchat/kanban
description: Kanban boards for fez docs — columns are headings, cards are checkboxes, moving a card moves a line. Agents move cards with fez_board_move; the board is just the markdown.

scripts.build: esbuild src/board.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/board.js && esbuild src/gui.tsx --bundle --format=iife --global-name=__fezExt --platform=browser --jsx=transform --jsx-factory=h --outfile=dist/gui.js && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/mcp.js
